articles.title: Is Darcy Kuemperâs NHL future becoming Los Angeles Kingsâ most intriguing question before opening night
articles.summary: NHL News: As the 2026-27 NHL season approaches, the Los Angeles Kings face a pivotal decision regarding goaltender Darcy Kuemper's future. With competing options and trade rumors swirling, can Kuemper reclaim his starting position?
articles.body: The Los Angeles Kings are entering the 2026-27 NHL season with a question mark at the goaltending position. Darcy Kuemper was the obvious No. 1, but his play dipped in 2025-26 after an injury, and Anton Forsberg played better down the stretch and took the playoff crease. According to the Kingsâ own training-camp preview, both veterans could be in the mix for the job, with Erik Portillo possibly in the NHL picture as well.Thereâs also been some NHL trade speculation surrounding Kuemper. He was mentioned in a recent report as a possible trade candidate, but thereâs no indication that Los Angeles Kings general manager Ken Holland is actively shopping him. Kuemper supposedly wants to stay in Los Angeles and fight for his starting spot.Could Darcy Kuemperâs future reshape Los Angeles Kingsâ NHL plans?Darcy Kuemperâs future could depend on his ability to regain the starting job for the Los Angeles Kings.Kuemper came into 2025-26 off a stellar season in which he posted a 31-11-7 record with a 2.02 goals-against average and .921 save percentage. His numbers dipped considerably in 2025-26, when he posted a 19-14-15 mark, 2.78 GAA and.891 save percentage.Anton Forsberg offers the Los Angeles Kings a real option in net. Forsberg had a 16-12-5 record, a 2.57 goals-against average and a.909 save percentage in 36 regular-season games. He then started all four playoff games against the Colorado Avalanche, adding to his case for a bigger role in 2026-27.That just makes training camp all the more important. The Kings recognise that Forsberg might seek more starts, and Kuemper is eager to regain his form. The organization could even start the season with Kuemper and Forsberg, plus Erik Portillo, all on the NHL roster.Could Darcy Kuemper trade rumors become more serious?The ongoing Darcy Kuemper trade rumours are still speculation and not confirmed trade discussions.The Hockey News listed Kuemper as a trade candidate if his role is reduced, but that doesnât mean Ken Holland is looking to make a deal. Kuemper wanting to remain with the Los Angeles Kings adds a whole other level to the situation.For now, the most obvious storyline is competition. If Kuemper makes the save, the Kings have little reason to move him. But if Forsberg makes himself the guy, the Kings could have a more difficult roster and salary decision to make.Kuemper will have to show more than improved stats in training camp. He needs to show that his movement, rebounding and consistency have returned after last seasonâs struggles.If he posts strong numbers in the preseason, it would go a long way toward reassuring the Kingsâ coaching staff and his teammates that he can still handle a starterâs workload.The immediate answer should not be trade speculation, but training camp and the opening weeks of the NHL season.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: A controversial ad for a driver is the latest clash between golf’s old guard and new world
articles.summary: The normally buttoned-up world of golf is dealing with its latest collision between traditional sensibilities and new age internet culture – and this time it’s putting into question how and whether those two worlds merge.
articles.body: The normally buttoned-up world of golf is dealing with its latest collision between traditional sensibilities and new age internet culture – and this time it’s putting into question how and whether those two worlds merge. The golf-focused media company Good Good and equipment maker Callaway are both under fire this week after the release of an advertisement for a new co-branded driver featuring personalities from Good Good. The ad started with a shocking image of Garrett Clark, one of the co-founders of Good Good, shoulder-checking Alexis Miestowski to the ground as she went to touch his driver. The advertisement quickly drew immense backlash and was pulled down, with Callaway and Good Good both facing intense questions over how an ad showing a violent act against a woman would be approved and posted. Early on Tuesday morning, Callaway CEO Chip Brewer admitted his company approved the ad and apologized for that mistake. “As we deal with the consequences of our mistake and complete our investigations, I want to make it clear that we sincerely apologize for the video,” Brewer wrote in a statement posted to X. “The content was inappropriate and does not reflect our values. To be clear: We are unequivocally against discrimination, domestic violence, or threatening behavior of any kind.” For its part, Good Good also apologized after the video was pulled on Saturday, saying, “Good Good has always stood for making the game of golf more inclusive to all, and we will continue to ensure that is our mission moving forward.” The involvement of Good Good in this controversy is particularly notable given the company’s place in the emerging ecosystem of internet golf. The company is among the leading brands as the sport explodes on social media, bringing in new fans to the game who prefer watching the ebullient personalities on the course to the normally demure and understated players who make up the professional ranks on the PGA Tour. Good Good’s place in the game has grown over the years since it was founded in 2020 and the company has branched out from content creation into merchandising, with its stylized “Good” hats prominent on fairways across the country. Good Good’s popularity is such that it made its way into golf’s upper echelon when it became the title partner for the Good Good Championship taking place this November in Austin, Texas. But it’s that partnership that has now come under scrutiny in the fallout of the ill-conceived advertisement as the PGA Tour takes in all the reaction – and evaluates Good Good’s response to it. PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp on Tuesday told reporters at Atlanta’s East Lake Golf Club, the scene of this weekend’s season-ending Tour Championship, that he was disappointed in Good Good’s reaction to the controversy, saying that the company did not show enough accountability. “Initially no. I think what we saw was concerning, and is clearly not aligned with PGA Tour values,” Rolapp said. “We take it very seriously. I think their initial response was disappointing. It was a bit defensive and late, but I think the responses are getting better.” When asked directly if the video and subsequent response would affect the tournament in November, Rolapp said, “It’s a bit of a fluid situation.” “We were disappointed at first. It sounds like in the last 24 hours they’ve made some progress. We’ll continue to monitor the situation and see how it develops,” he said. The PGA Tour is golf’s preeminent brand and has nearly 100 years of history as the home of men’s golf’s biggest names, but it has also faced challenges in the 2020s like never before. From the creation of LIV Golf as a big-money alternative tour for players to online media companies like Good Good that attract viewers to a much more relaxed and internet-savvy presentation of the game, the tour has been making numerous changes to try and attract new fans and keep its current fans engaged amid these new challenges to its hegemony. But in some ways, the tour has embraced these golf influencers and personalities to modernize its brand. The usual rank-and-file of reporters and photographers at tour events is now also scattered with independent content creators making videos for their own social media channels, and the tour works with some of them to promote events weeks ahead of time. The Good Good Championship in a few months was seen as a novel concept bringing the old and new worlds of golf together in a groundbreaking way. However, the Good Good/Callaway video and its aftermath represents the clearest clash of boisterous, sometimes over-the-top internet influencers and the modest and conservative image of the PGA Tour – especially when the two are in business together. It’s making for some intense conversations that could shape the future of these kinds of partnerships.

articles.title: NHL 27 Drops Gameplay and Presentation Deep Dive Video Detailing Video Game's New Features
articles.summary: EA Sports released a new deep-dive video showcasing NHL 27's gameplay and presentation on Tuesday.
articles.body:
EA Sports released a new deep-dive video showcasing NHL 27's gameplay and presentation on Tuesday.

Instead of three global shared strategies, there are 32 team-specific playbooks in the video game.

Players can also see how playbooks influence the game with a whiteboard-style visualizer that displays team positioning by zone and situation.

Meanwhile, the commentary team for the game will now include ESPN's John Buccigross and CHSN's Darren Pang.

As for the visual presentation, there has been a "complete overhaul" of the graphics package to match the style of "modern" broadcasts (2:56 mark). Goal animations and intro transitions to better reflect game situations have also been added.

Updated team-authentic goal songs are a feature of the upcoming game as well.

NHL 27 is set to drop on Sept. 11, although players who pre-order the Deluxe Edition will have access to the game on Sept. 4.

articles.title: Islam Makhachev makes bold Alexander Volkanovski prediction as Movsar Evloev prepares for UFC 333 title fight
articles.summary: International Sports News: Islam Makhachev has made a clear pick for the Alexander Volkanovski vs. Movsar Evloev title fight, and it may surprise some UFC fans. The UFC welterwe.
articles.body: Islam Makhachev has made a clear pick for the Alexander Volkanovski vs. Movsar Evloev title fight, and it may surprise some UFC fans. The UFC welterweight champion believes Evloevâs youth could help him beat Volkanovski at UFC 333. Makhachev also feels the Australian is no longer at the same peak he reached a few years ago, even though he still sees him as one of the best fighters in the sport.Islam Makhachev predicts Movsar Evloev can beat Alexander VolkanovskiVolkanovski and Evloev will meet for the UFC featherweight title on October 24 at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi. The UFC has officially confirmed the fight as the main event of UFC 333. Volkanovski enters the bout as champion, while Evloev is still unbeaten with a 20-0 record.Makhachev knows what Volkanovski brings because the two have already fought twice. Their first meeting came at UFC 284, where Makhachev won a close decision. He then stopped Volkanovski with a head kick in the first round of their rematch at UFC 294.Now, despite those wins, Makhachev is not picking his former opponent to keep the featherweight belt.Speaking to reporters in Russia, Makhachev backed Evloev and pointed to the age gap between the two fighters.âItâs no secret and he himself knows that the fight wonât be easy, that Volkanovski is a tough opponent for anyone. But I think Movsar will manage with his youth. Volkanovski, honestly speaking, is not at the same peak he was a couple of years ago. Even though he is still one of the best fighters. I think itâll be a very competitive fight but I hope Movsar will do his job.âSherdog reported Makhachevâs prediction on August 25.The prediction is interesting because Makhachev did not dismiss Volkanovski. Instead, he pointed to something that could matter over five rounds: whether the 37-year-old champion can still perform at the level he showed during his best years.Evloev, meanwhile, has built an unbeaten record and earned his first UFC title shot. The UFCâs official event listing identifies him as the No. 1-ranked contender going into the fight.Alexander Volkanovski reveals what could happen after Movsar Evloev fightThere is another reason this title fight has extra weight for Volkanovski. The champion recently admitted that a very bad performance against Evloev could make him think about retirement.Volkanovski told 10 News that he has no plans to retire right now. However, he said the result and the damage from the fight could affect what he decides next.âIf things go terribly wrong, alright, weâre done. If things go very well, like the last one, no damage, go through, alright, weâll keep it rolling. Taking each fight as it goes, just trying to be real with it. But I donât have plans on retiring right now. Moneyâs always good.â MMA Fighting reported his comments.That puts more focus on what happens when Volkanovski faces the undefeated Evloev. articles.title: Matt Cardona Posts Photo from Hospital After Torn Triceps Injury During WWE Main Event Match
articles.summary: Two days after confirming he tore his triceps during a match on Friday night, WWE superstar Matt Cardona was in the hospital.
articles.body:
Two days after confirming he tore his triceps during a match on Friday night, WWE superstar Matt Cardona was in the hospital.

Cardona posted a picture on social media of himself in a hospital bed.

This comes on the heels of Cardona posting an image of his left arm with a wrap on it, announcing he suffered an injury during a match against Kit Wilson taped for Main Event .

The timeline for Cardona to return depends on the severity of the injury. It can take up to one year to get back to full range of motion if surgery is required, though some wrestlers have returned much faster.

Back in 2013, John Cena was out for only two months after undergoing surgery to repair a torn triceps following his SummerSlam match with Daniel Bryan.

Cardona made a few appearances on WWE television while working for TNA last year, but he officially returned to the promotion in January after signing a contract in January.

The former Intercontinental champion has been working on the SmackDown brand with his wife and recently-crowned WWE women's champion Chelsea Green.

articles.title: Carlos Baleba joins Manchester United in transfer from Brighton
articles.summary: Cameroon midfielder joins EPL powerhouse for a fee understood to be worth up to 70 million pounds.
articles.body:
Manchester United have signed Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba from fellow English Premier League club Brighton.

The 22-year-old is the third midfielder signed by the Red Devils during the summer transfer window.

“Manchester United is pleased to confirm that Carlos Baleba has joined the club, subject to registration,” the 20-time Premier League champions said in a statement on Tuesday.

United said Baleba signed a deal until 2031 with the option to extend for a further year, but it did not disclose the value.

It is understood that Brighton had been holding out for a deal worth $100m although United are believed to have agreed a 70-million-pound ($95m) transfer fee, which takes their spending on midfield reinforcements to more than 150 million pounds ($204m) in this window.

Baleba was born in Douala, Cameroon, but started his professional career in 2022 with French Ligue 1 side Lille. The next year, he joined Brighton, where he made 79 starts and registered more than 100 appearances for the Seagulls.

United had been linked with a move for Baleba, who plays in a defensive role in midfield, last summer and again in the January transfer window.

Baleba, who follows fellow midfielders Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos to Old Trafford this summer, has made 16 appearances for Cameroon.

“Baleba has already established himself as one of the most talented midfielders in the Premier League,” United’s statement said.

“During the 2024/25 season, his combined number of tackles and interceptions was the sixth-highest among midfielders in the league, while he also ranked fourth-highest for progressive ball carries per 90 minutes.

“Last season, Baleba played 31 games in the Premier League, ranking in the top eight per cent of players for combined tackles and interceptions as well as the top one per cent for second balls won, helping Brighton & Hove Albion to qualify for the UEFA Conference League.”

The trio of midfield signings by United will help to fill the gap left by Brazil’s former Real Madrid star Casemiro, who has joined Major League Soccer side Inter Miami in the United States.

“It is an incredible feeling to join the club of my dreams,” Baleba said.

“Playing at Old Trafford is always special, but the opportunity to do so as a Manchester United player will be a real honour.

“I cannot wait to work with Michael Carrick. His experience and knowledge of the game make him the perfect coach to help me to reach the highest level.”

articles.title: Luke Littler suffers Players Championship 27 quarter-final exit with loss to eventual winner Jermaine Wattimena
articles.summary: Luke Littler has won every major on PDC circuit so far in 2026 in bid for historic clean sweep; world No 1 must finish in top 64 of Players Championship Order of Merit in order to qualify for Finals in November; 19-year-old lost 6-5 to eventual PC27 winner Jermaine Wattimena in last eight
articles.body:
Luke Littler's bid to qualify for the Players Championship Finals, and keep alive his hopes of claiming a historic clean sweep of PDC major titles in 2026, suffered a blow with a quarter-final exit at PC27.

Littler was beaten 6-5 by Jermaine Wattimena in a final-leg decider, with the Dutchman going on to take the title in Leicester, overcoming countryman Kevin Doets 8-6 in the final.

Littler beat Archie Self 6-2, Arno Merk 6-3 and then William O'Connor 6-3 to set up a last-16 tie with Chris Dobey, who he thrashed 6-0, before losing out to eventual champion Wattimena.

The world No 1 has won every major title on the PDC circuit so far in 2026 - the World Championship, Masters, UK Open, Premier League, World Cup of Darts and World Matchplay.

He still needs to win the World Series, World Grand Prix, European Championship, Grand Slam of Darts and Players Championship Finals this season in order to achieve something no-one has ever managed in the sport.

Can Littler still qualify for Players Championship Finals?

The major obstacle standing in the way of a Littler clean sweep is that only the top 64 in the Players Championship Order of Merit make it through to the finals in Minehead in November, with the projected cut-off expected to be over £30,000 in earnings.

The winner of each Players Championship event scoops up £15,000 but Littler was able to secure only £4,000 by reaching the quarter-finals on his season-debut outing.

The 19-year-old opted out of the first 26 events before entering PC27 and 28 in Leicester, meaning he needs to have strong showings in the final seven scheduled floor events to stand a chance of qualifying.

PC28 on Wednesday, also being held at the Mattioli Arena in Leicester, gives him another opportunity to claim a tournament win and boost his finals hopes.

How Wattimena stormed to PC27 title

Wattimena fended off a late fightback Doets to clinch his third PDC ranking title with victory in the Players Championship 27 showpiece on Tuesday.

Following his dramatic, first career win against Littler, sealed with a clutch 115 checkout on tops in a last-leg decider, Wattimena produced further heroics in his semi-final against Luke Woodhouse, reeling off six straight legs from 4-1 down, aided by an astonishing flurry of five ton-plus finishes.

Wattimena converted 136, 135, 115, 127 and 128 outshots to complete the comeback, before winning six straight legs against Doets to power into a commanding 6-2 lead.

Doets responded by winning four of the next five to threaten an improbable turnaround, only for Wattimena to fire in a brilliant 11-darter en route to victory.

"I played really well today but some games I made difficult for myself," conceded Wattimena, who reclaims a place in the world's top 16 at the expense of Ross Smith.

"I always play really well against Luke to be honest. Even when I lose I play well, and that 115 finish against Luke gave me big confidence.

"I didn't realise I hit five ton-plus finishes in the semi-final because you're busy with the game, but I'm very happy with this win."

Nathan Aspinall was another high-profile name in action, and the Stockport star struck perfection during his opening round tie against Thibault Tricole, before succumbing to Mickey Mansell in round three.

articles.title: ESPN Addresses 'Completely False' Rumors About Future WWE Contract After Historic $1.6B Deal
articles.summary: ESPN has strongly denied an SEScoops report stating that it has already decided against renewing its five-year contract with WWE to be the exclusive American home for all Premium Live Events (PLEs).
articles.body:
ESPN has strongly denied an SEScoops report stating that it has already decided against renewing its five-year contract with WWE to be the exclusive American home for all Premium Live Events (PLEs).

Ben Cafardo of ESPN's Communications team released a statement on the matter, calling the rumors "categorically false."

Per CNBC's Alex Sherman , who cited people familiar with the deal back in Aug. 2025, ESPN is paying WWE an average of $325 million per year from 2026-2030.

ESPN Unlimited has shown WWE PLE's since Wrestlepalooza in Sept. 2025. That got the deal off to a big start, as the event featured John Cena, who was nearing the end of his retirement tour, taking on Brock Lesnar.

WWE has been promoted quite a bit on ESPN networks since the deal struck. All the biggest WWE events have appeared under the ESPN banner, including WrestleMania, SummerSlam and Royal Rumble.

WWE and ESPN appear to be all-in on this deal off the bat, and the one-year anniversary of the first PLE on ESPN Unlimited is rapidly approaching.

Ultimately, ESPN has clearly stated it's not looking for a way to back out. And in other news, three PLE's remain in 2026: Sunday Night's Main Event (Sept. 6), Money in the Bank (Oct. 10) and Survivor Series: WarGames (Nov. 28).

articles.title: González Fuertes sobre la jugada del Granada-Mallorca: "Estas cosas hacen mucho daño al estamento arbitral"
articles.standfirst: El exárbitro lamenta en Radio MARCA la polémica por el gol del Granada después de que se escuchara el pitido del colegiado tras el saque de esquina
articles.summary: El exárbitro lamenta en Radio MARCA la polémica por el gol del Granada después de que se escuchara el pitido del colegiado tras el saque de esquina
articles.body: Pablo González Fuertes fue protagonista en Radio MARCA para analizar algunas de las situaciones arbitrales que más dudas están generando en este inicio de temporada. El exárbitro se detuvo especialmente en la polémica del Granada-Mallorca, donde un gol quedó marcado por un pitido del colegiado que se produjo después de que el balón fuera golpeado en el saque de esquina. Además, aclaró y explicó con detalle la nueva normativa sobre cuándo los jugadores deben abandonar el terreno de juego después de recibir asistencia médica, y cómo funciona la nueva norma aplicada a los porteros. El exárbitro fue contundente con la acción del gol del Granada. El jugador puso el balón en juego y después se escuchó el silbato del colegiado. «El jugador atacante pone el balón en juego y posteriormente hay un sonido del silbato que invalidaría todo lo que pasa después», explicó. Para González Fuertes, lo más difícil de entender es que la jugada acabara en gol. «Lo que es inexplicable es que se dé gol», aseguró. Además, considera que la situación perjudica al colectivo arbitral: «Estas cosas no pueden pasar porque hacen mucho daño al estamento y a los compañeros». El excolegiado cree que había una solución sencilla para evitar la polémica: «Yo hubiese vuelto a pitar dos o tres veces, parar el partido y volver a reanudar el saque de esquina». González Fuertes defendió además que el arbitraje de élite requiere algo más que aplicar el reglamento. «Es saber gestionar situaciones complejas y saber darle una solución a esas situaciones», señaló. El VAR no podía corregir la acción porque el sonido del silbato no forma parte de los elementos revisables. «Esto no es una acción revisable por el VAR, porque el VAR no puede revisar audios», explicó. En la sala VOR no se escucha el sonido ambiente, sino únicamente las comunicaciones del equipo arbitral. Además, una imagen del árbitro con el silbato en la boca tampoco demuestra por sí sola que haya pitado: «Muchas veces te llevas el silbato en la boca y no pitas». Sobre una posible impugnación, González Fuertes lo encuadró como un error arbitral: «El error es intrínseco a nuestra profesión, hay que vivir con él», aunque reconoció que «hay errores que hacen más daño que otros». El exárbitro también explicó la norma sobre los futbolistas atendidos sobre el terreno de juego. «Todos los jugadores que son atendidos en el campo, en el que el cuerpo médico entra a atenderles, van a salir fuera y van a estar un minuto», indicó. La misma regla se aplica cuando el árbitro detiene el partido por una posible lesión. No ocurre, en cambio, si el jugador sale voluntariamente del campo para ser atendido o si ya estaba fuera cuando recibió la asistencia. Hay varias excepciones. Si el jugador atendido va a ser sustituido, el cambio se realiza inmediatamente. Tampoco debe salir si dos futbolistas del mismo equipo chocan, si va a lanzar un penalti o si acaba de recibir una falta por la que el rival ha sido amonestado o expulsado. En los golpes en la cabeza hay una casuística diferente. Si el árbitro detiene el juego, los jugadores deben salir, aunque si no necesitan asistencia pueden regresar inmediatamente. «Yo creo que esto lo van a cambiar, porque esto no tiene mucho sentido», reconoció González Fuertes. El objetivo de la nueva regla para los guardametas es evitar pérdidas de tiempo. Si un portero necesita atención, el entrenador tiene diez segundos para elegir a un compañero que permanezca un minuto fuera. Si no lo hace, será el capitán quien tenga que salir. Hay excepciones cuando existe una lesión evidente. «Si tú le pitas una falta al portero porque se acaba de llevar un golpe y le tienen que atender, pues no está perdiendo tiempo», explicó. Lo mismo sucede ante una hemorragia o una lesión grave: «No está perdiendo tiempo, pues ya no tiene por qué salir el compañero».

articles.summary: Kylian Mbappe and Jude Bellingham headline against Sociedad as Real seek consecutive wins to open La Liga season.
articles.body:
Who: Real Madrid vs Real Sociedad What: Spanish football’s La Liga Where: Bernabeu Stadium in Madrid, Spain When: August 26, at 9pm (19:00 GMT) How to follow: Al Jazeera Sport will bring you all the buildup from 16:00 GMT ahead of our live text commentary stream

As Real Madrid and Real Sociedad go head-to-head on Wednesday, it will match up one of last season’s trophy winners in Spain against a side desperate to put their hands on silverware this time around.

list 1 of 4 Premier League: Chelsea start Alonso era with thrilling 3–2 win at Fulham

list 2 of 4 Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor

list 3 of 4 Eto’o says embattled FIFA President Infantino ‘hasn’t done anything wrong’

list 4 of 4 Ceferin won’t challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency but tells him to quit

Either Los Blancos or their rivals Barcelona have appeared in all but four of the last 12 finals of the Copa Del Rey, Spain’s premier cup competition, but Sociedad claimed victory last season, beating Atletico Madrid.

Real, meanwhile, were struggling to keep pace with Barca in La Liga and head into the new term seeking to avoid a third season without a trophy.

Not since 2006 have Real endured such a run.

Al Jazeera Sport takes a look at the La Liga fixture where Jose Mourinho makes his first appearance in front of a home crowd on his return as Real manager.

How has Real Madrid’s La Liga season begun?

Mourinho’s second spell in charge of Los Blancos began with a last-gasp 2-1 victory at Espanyol in La Liga on Saturday

Real needed substitute Carlos Espi to pounce in the 90th minute to grab the winner after Jude Bellingham opened the scoring in Los Blancos’ opening fixture of the season, before Alex Calatrava levelled for the home side in Barcelona.

“I think that we deserved to win but that Espanyol didn’t deserve to lose,” Mourinho told reporters.

“They didn’t have any players at the World Cup and have been working together for a long time, and you could see that.”

On top of the big-name starters, Mourinho sent on two more new arrivals in the form of record signing Yan Diomande and Marc Cucurella; however, it was only Espi’s strike – from a loose ball in the box – that saved the day.

What challenges does Mourinho face at Real Madrid?

Back in charge of Madrid 13 years after leaving , Portuguese veteran Mourinho must bring the dressing room under control after the chaos of last season – and prevent Barcelona from securing a La Liga threepeat.

Mourinho started the match at Espanyol with superstars Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Junior and Bellingham, as well as handing debuts to Bernardo Silva, Denzel Dumfries and Ibrahima Konate.

Bellingham had an excellent first season at Madrid after arriving from Borussia Dortmund, but the subsequent two were disappointing, both for him and the club, who failed to win a major trophy in either.

Mourinho installed him in attacking midfield with a licence to roam, and the England international was heavily involved before his goal, which came via a header from Arda Guler’s dangerous crossed free-kick.

Mbappe got in behind on the right of the area in the early stages only to be denied by the keeper, and the French forward, La Liga’s top scorer in both of his two seasons at the club, was far from his lethal best.

On the left flank, Vinicius had little impact beyond winning a series of fouls from Espanyol players who were determined to shut him down by any means.

Why has Mourinho said Real Madrid’s Vinicius needs protection?

Mourinho, once known for his fiery personality and frequent touchline outbursts, says he wants to help Vinicius Junior control his emotions better.

The Real coach thinks Vinicius is being unfairly targeted, but the star forward can do better when reacting to provocations after the Brazilian was involved in several incidents with opposing fans and players at Espanyol.

“There is on the field and off the field,” Mourinho said. “The reaction to fans and insults, obviously, if they are not racist or homophobic insults, but the typical insults by fans, then I think he can control it better.

“In the game, when it comes to the fouls and the accumulation of frustration that he feels, that’s the responsibility of the referees, or the judges, as I like to call them, in terms of their responsibility to protect the players and the game.”

How is Mourinho’s relationship with Vinicius after Benfica controversy?

Mourinho said it’s harder to help Vinicius when it comes to the in-game incidents, but when it’s about his relationship with the opposing fans, then “it’s something that we can work on”.

Last year, Mourinho was criticised for attacking Vinicius’ character after the player accused an opponent of racially insulting him during a Champions League match against Benfica. The coach in charge of Benfica at the time suggested that the Brazil forward incited opposing players with his celebrations after scoring.

“When I was Benfica’s coach, I was only interested about Benfica,” Mourinho said.

The veteran Portuguese coach said it has become obvious the difference in the treatment on the field towards Vinicius and towards other players.

“It’s gone into a spiral in which the opponents know what they can do and what they can’t do,” he said. “If the players can provoke and pressure Vini, either physically or with words, if the yellow card is only shown after 10 fouls, if there can be violence, then it’s a type of treatment that I don’t like.”

Real Sociedad have also only played one game this season, with the La Liga start staggered to help clubs heavily affected by World Cup call-ups in the summer.

The match at Real Betis resulted in a 1-0 reverse, though, with Rodrigo Riquelme’s tidy volley from Cucho Hernandez’s cross settling an otherwise tight and even game.

Betis finished fifth in the table last season, and Sociedad’s two away games to begin the campaign mark a tough start, especially given they won only three of their 19 league games on the road in the previous campaign.

What happened the last time Real Madrid played Sociedad?

Real won 4-1 in the last meeting between the sides, the corresponding La Liga fixture last season.

Vinicius Junior scored twice from the spot while Gonzalo Garcia and Federico Valverde also netted.

Sociedad had pulled level through Mikel Oyarzabal’s 21st-minute spotkick but Real took a 3-1 lead at half-time.

Sociedad last beat Real 2-0 in a La Liga encounter in May 2023. Takefusa Kubo and Ander Barrenetxea scored on either side of Dani Carvajal’s sending-off to hand the home side the win.

Sociedad stunned Real with a 4-3 Copa Del Rey win at Bernabeu in February 2020.

Martin Odegaard, now the captain of Arsenal, opened the scoring before a brace from Alexander Isak helped Sociedad to a 3-0 lead by the 56th minute.

Marcelo immediately pulled one back for Real before Mikel Merino restored the three-goal advantage with 20 minutes to play.

A late salvo from Rodrygo and Nacho set up a tight finish, which included Sociedad being reduced to 10 men when Andoni Gorosabel was given his marching orders.

Sociedad recorded a 2-0 win at Bernabeu in January 2019

Willian Jose and Ruben Pardo scored on either side of Lucas Vazquez’s 61st-minute red card for Real.

Sociedad have only won one of their last 20 matches at Real Madrid in La Liga.

They have scored an impressive 19 goals in that run, but have also shipped 54 at the other end, resulting in 16 wins for Real in that run.

The Opta supercomputer has given Real Madrid a 66 percent chance of winning the match, while Sociedad are only afforded a 15 percent chance.

There have been 158 meetings between the sides, with Real Madrid winning 91 times and Sociedad claiming 27 victories.

Eder Militao (muscle), Rodrygo (knee), Raul Asencio (thigh) and Ferland Mendy (hip) all remain sidelined for Real

Endrick (muscle), Thiago Pitarch (knee) and Aurelien Tchouameni (muscle) are doubts and could also miss out.

Jude Bellingham is expected to play, despite nursing his ankle with an ice pack after being substituted in the win at Espanyol.

Former Real defender Alvaro Odriozola is back with the club where he began his career, but will miss the match due to a long-term knee injury.

Pablo Marin (muscle), Jon Gorrotxategi (muscle) and Goncalo Guedes (muscle) all face late fitness tests.

articles.title: El Rayo abre la puerta a escuchar ofertas por Pathé Ciss
articles.standfirst: Raúl Martín Presa cambia el tono y acepta valorar propuestas por el internacional senegalés, que este martes acudió a la Ciudad Deportiva, pero no entrenó por segundo día consecutivo
articles.summary: Raúl Martín Presa cambia el tono y acepta valorar propuestas por el internacional senegalés, que este martes acudió a la Ciudad Deportiva, pero no entrenó por segundo día consecutivo
articles.body: El futuro de Pathé Ciss entra en días clave. El centrocampista del Rayo Vallecano ha acudido este martes a la Ciudad Deportiva, pero no se ha entrenado por segundo día consecutivo junto al resto de sus compañeros. El jugador mantiene firme su postura: quiere salir este verano porque considera que su ciclo en Vallecas está acabado. La situación ha provocado dos días de reuniones de mucha tensión entre las partes. Pathé lleva tiempo pidiendo al club que escuche las ofertas que han llegado por él. Hasta ahora, el Rayo se había mantenido cerrado en banda y se remitía a los 10 millones de euros de su cláusula. La novedad es que Raúl Martín Presa se ha mostrado por primera vez en los últimos años permeable a escuchar ofertas por el internacional senegalés. Un cambio de tono importante a falta de un año para la finalización de su contrato y después de que el futbolista haya decidido no ejercitarse con el grupo durante dos días consecutivos. El Rayo todavía no ha autorizado su salida, pero por primera vez acepta sentarse a valorar propuestas. La diferencia no es menor en una operación que venía bloqueada por la postura firme del club y por el deseo del jugador de iniciar una nueva etapa lejos de Vallecas. Pathé ha sido una pieza importante desde su llegada al Rayo en 2021, pero entiende que este verano debe marcar un punto de inflexión. Su contrato termina en 2027 y el club sabe que el margen para sacar rendimiento económico a una posible venta empieza a estrecharse. Los próximos días serán decisivos para comprobar si alguno de los clubes interesados transforma ese seguimiento en una propuesta capaz de convencer al Rayo. Besiktas y Al Shabab están atentos, también hay vías en España, y Pathé espera que esta vez el club sí se siente a escuchar. Después de años con la puerta cerrada, el escenario empieza a moverse.

articles.summary: St Helens legend Jonny Lomax announces he is to retire at the end of the Super League season.
articles.body:
St Helens legend Jonny Lomax has announced he is to retire at the end of the Super League season.

The 35-year-old, who has not featured since fracturing his jaw in the defeat by Warrington Wolves in June, has made 388 appearances for Saints, winning five Grand Finals, one Challenge Cup and a World Club Challenge.

He won four caps for Great Britain and 11 for England, including a World Cup final appearance against Australia in 2017.

"Over the last 20 years, I have been able to live out a boyhood dream. Achieving far more than I could ever have imagined. Representing and captaining my hometown club and, of course, the pinnacle, representing England and Great Britain," he told the club website. , external

"I have been fortunate enough to meet some incredible people along the way, experiencing some incredible highs with them. As well as some testing times too."

He added: "I will retire at the age of 36, grateful for the life the game has given me, knowing I have given it everything I could, with the scars to prove it (19 operations, including 12 knee operations by the age of 26). Despite this, I still feel lucky.

"For those that have supported me throughout it allâ¦ I hope I have been able to do you proud."

Saints chairman Eamonn McManus called Lomax, who made his debut in March 2009 aged 18, "the bravest of brave in the bravest of sports".

St Helens are seventh in Super League with three games of the campaign to go.

They are two points behind reigning champions Hull KR, who they play in the final game of the regular season, as they look to secure a place in the top six and avoid missing out on the Super League play-offs for the first time.

articles.body: Un par de semanas después de anunciar de manera sorpresiva su salida de TUDN, la conductora Valeria Marín finalmente reveló los motivos por los que decidió no continuar en Televisa después de la cobertura de la Copa del Mundo y también aclaró los rumores de su salida y una supuesta relación con el analista de esa misma cadena deportiva, Marc Crosas. Recordemos que hace un par de semanas, tras el anuncio de su salida de TUDN, comenzaron a circular varias versiones sobre las razones por las que no continuará en Televisa, entre ellas, se habló de una petición de aumento de sueldo, que habría provocado que tomará la decisión de no continuar luego de 7 años en esa empresa. Valeria Marín llegó a TUDN hace 7 años y señaló que después de pensarlo y cerrar la cobertura de la Copa del Mundo tomó la decisión de salir de la cadena deportiva y además aseguró estar contenta de haber dado un paso al costado. "Después del Mundial, después de pensarlo, dije 'me despido con una cobertura increíble', yo creo que ya hice lo que tenía que hacer en este lugar, el lugar también me dio lo que me tenía que haber dado o lo que me gané y sería bonito cerrarlo en lo más alto. Estoy súper feliz con la decisión que tomé y muy emocionada por lo que se pueda venir". Estas declaraciones las hizo en el podcast 'Sabor a Fútbol', en donde también hizo referencia un par de veces a su pareja, el actor Julián Gil quien según las palabras de la conductora le dio un par de consejos antes de tomar la decisión de salir de TUDN: "Me dijo ' no pongas todos los huevos en la misma canasta', y sí, estoy dejando a la televisora más fuerte en México pero ver que hay un mundo mucho más grande, en donde puedes tener muchas más opciones Desde luego uno de los puntos más atractivos del poscast fue cuando hablaron sobre los rumores que rodearon su salida de TUDN, incluido un aparente romance con el panelista Marc Crosas y también el aumento de sueldo que derivó en la decisión que tomó: "Yo di todo, ellos me dieron todo. Yo quiero más como cualquier profesional, siempre aspiramos a más, quizás el canal no me lo puede dar". Y cuando se le preguntó sobre la relación que algunos rumores instalaron con su compañero en TUDN, respondió a manera de broma: "Confieso que somos pareja swinger, Marc si entra en la ecuación pero salgo de la cancha yo y entre Marc, entonces son 'Juli' y Marc", al tiempo en el que comenzó a reírse, "esas veriones ni las aclaro y dan risa, la gente no está preparada para esta conversación".

articles.title: WWE NXT Results, Winners, Live Grades, Reaction, Highlights Before Heatwave 2026
articles.summary: On the week ahead of Heatwave, NXT presented a final show on August 25 in the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.
articles.body:
On the week ahead of Heatwave, NXT presented a final show on August 25 in the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.

As part of a Championship Summit, Tony D'Angelo would meet his future challengers Grayson Waller, Cruz Montana and Zilla Fatu while Kendal Grey exchanged final words with Kelani Jordan.

Saquon Shugars and Dion Lennox opened the show in a Weaponized Steel Cage. EK Prosper challenged Rey Fénix for the AAA Cruiserweight Championship.

This was only the foundation of an important night. Check out all the results, grades and highlights for NXT below.

Weaponized Steel Cage: Saquon Shugars vs. Dion Lennox

Last Time in Action: Dion Lennox defeated Saquon Shugars (NXT, August 11).

Lennox tossed a trash can at Shugars as he entered the cage, starting an immediate brawl. Lennox relied on his surroundings early, tossing Shugars repeatedly into the steel.

Shugars found a way to fire back, trapping Lennox in a trash can which he attacked with a trash can lid and Missile Dropkick.

Lennox fought free and dropped Shugars' back onto a chair into the Picture-in-Picture break.

Out of the break, Lennox fired up, tossing Lennox into the cage and flying out of the corner with a fast Crossbody.

He whipped Lennox into a kendo stick followed by face-planting Lennox into a steel chair. Lennox responded with a Spinebuster onto a trash can for a near-fall.

Lennox began targeting the leg of Shugars, using a steel chair and Shugars' own bat to target the left knee.

Shugars tried to send Lennox through a table with a Sunset Flip Powerbomb, but his knee gave out.

Shugars kept fighting through the limp and, in a final desperation move, went all the way to the top of the cage for a Crossbody to seal the win.

This was by far the best these two have looked in singles action, especially against one another.

Plunder matches especially with this many pre-set weapons gave them the structure their standard matches lacked.

The aggression of Lennox is far more effective when he is swinging chairs and tossing his opponent into a cage than utilizing his standard offense.

He also showed some impressive ingenuity throughout, combining weapons with the cage that sold his intellect.

This match also gave Shugars a chance to lean into his ability to sell pain, highlighting his resilience while the crowd cheered him on.

The ending was hampered by an early table break, but Shugars soldiered through and still hit a nice top-of-the-cage Crossbody, even if it did not look as devastating as they originally planned.

This should be the end of the rivalry for now. Shugars does not need to go through Osiris Griffin and Cutler James. He just needs to move on.

Let Shugars start building a resume that can allow him to challenge for the North American Championship while DarkState finds a new target.

Booker T oddly clarified that Shugars and Lennox don't hate each other. They just have "bad blood".

Vic Joseph explained that this could have been on Heatwave, but Robert Stone did not believe these two could wait. Booker again oddly questioned if this would have made the premium live event card.

"Use the Table" is a new obnoxious chant the NXT audience provided in place of "We Want Tables".

Shugars Superkicked Lennox after trapping him in a trash can on top of a table, only for the table to break early before the finish.

Nattie and Jaida Parker Agree to a Submission Match at Heatwave

Jaida Parker asked Thea Hail to stay in the back before she headed to the ring to face down Nattie.

The Low-Key Legend explained that she came to NXT to fight Ms. Parker, but she saw a Jaida that had grown soft and failed in her potential.

Jaida called out that Nattie tried to break her, but she only fired up a woman that was ready to embarrass her.

The two agreed to fight at Heatwave in a Submission match.

It is far too rare in the NXT women's division to see two stars just talk without interruption, especially without it quickly turning to violence.

That made this fairly basic promo stand out. Ms. Parker rode a supportive crowd to talking her way through Nattie, selling her confidence.

Even though The Low-Key Legend is the favorite on paper in this type of match, Jaida came out of this selling that there is no way that Nattie could make her tap out again.

Jaida should win against Nattie, and this win should set her up to take the next step to gold in NXT. She is ready for bigger opportunities.

In a backstage interview, Tony D'Angelo ran down all his challengers, promising none of them were ready for his fight.

The Vanity Project met Sarah Schreiber at a bowling alley where they called Myles Bornes and Tavion Heights fake friends while talking up Myka Lockwood as their secret weapon.

Last Time in Action: Kam Hendrix defeated Mason Rook (NXT, August 11); Keanu Carver defeated EK Prosper (NXT, August 4).

Carver teased an early inside cradle then took the best offense of Hendrix and smiled. The Showtime Kick could not even keep Carver down for two.

A pair of Release German Suplexes followed by a Pounce sent Hendrix to the floor. Showtime poked Carver in the eye, but as the referee talked to Carver, Mason Rook laid out Hendrix with a Running Crossbody.

Carver followed up with a Bridging Fisherman Suplex for the victory.

The positive was that Carver looked great. He shrugged off Hendrix's best offense and showed off a growing variety of moves in his arsenal.

It feels like Carver has fully landed in NXT, and his natural growth in the company makes him an easy choice to win gold soon.

The negative was a rushed and flat finish that made out that Carver needed Rook's help to seal the win in a match he was dominating.

It also was noticeable that Carver and Hendrix are a bad pair with limited in-ring chemistry. This is definitely not a match to quickly revisit.

Hendrix can continue feuding with Rook while Carver should look to the champions that leave Heatwave with the gold.

While big names are challenging Tony D'Angelo, Carver feels like a better long-term bet for NXT as a future NXT champion.

NXT showed footage of Carver finding out last minute that he would fight Hendrix. Carver teased anger but gladly accepted the challenge.

The crowd did not know how to react in this impromptu heel vs. heel match, but Carver won them over more, signaling he might be slowly turning.

In a pre-tape, Zilla Fatu promised to make a splash immediately in NXT.

Last Time in Action: Kali Armstrong alongside Kelani Jordan defeated WrenQCC (NXT, August 18); Zaria defeated Wren Sinclair to defend the Women's North American Championship (NXT, August 11).

Zaria and Kali began quickly testing each other's strength. The women's North American champion was too much for the former Evolve women's champion.

Instead of strength though, it was speed that gave Kali an edge as she knocked Zaria outside and caught her with a Springboard Crossbody into the PIP break.

Back from break, Kali kept control with an explosive Superplex. The two exchanged strikes in the center of the ring that ended with Kali standing tall.

Kali set up the Kali Connection, but Zaria countered into a Spear followed by an F5, only for Kali roll through into a Sunset Flip pin for the shock victory.

This was a great showcase for Kali. Zaria let the NXT newcomer look like a real threat by pushing Kali to her most dynamic performance on NXT so far.

This was not just a showcase of the explosive power of Kali. It was instead about the dynamic athleticism of one of NXT's most intriguing rising stars.

Kali did not need to actually beat Zaria, who has been well protected lately, but she will add more unpredictability to the Heatwave Unification match.

The best bet is for Zaria to take all the gold, but Kali is also a priority star in NXT. Zaria could easily go after the NXT Championship instead.

Kali def. Zaria by pinfall to earn a spot in the Heatwave championship unification match.

In a pre-tape, Kelani Jordan talked about how she has done everything in NXT and been disrespected constantly.

Kendal Grey talked with Wren Sinclair and NASCAR racer William Sawalich about doctor concerns about her balance for her title match against Lani.

BirthRight vs. Sean Legacy, DVD, Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno

Last Time in Action: This was the last time Lexis King, Charlie Dempsey, Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo and Uriah Connors have teamed up as a foursome since NXT Countdown to Stand & Deliver (April 4). This was the first time Sean Legacy, Dorian Van Dux, Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno have worked as a foursome.

The action quickly picked up as BirthRight could not contain the speed and ferocity of Legacy, DVD, Dar and Romeo.

Connors managed to trip up Romeo though, pulling him outside and face-planting him on the floor into the commercial break.

BirthRight continued to dominate Romeo back from break until Romeo managed to flip past everyone to DVD hot tag.

Dux dived onto BirthRight then tagged in Legacy to set up a Springboard 450 on Stacks, but King broke up the pin.

Dempsey and Dar tagged in before the babyfaces began an explosive comeback, diving onto the field. In the chaos, Dempsey caught The Scottish Supernova with a Bridging Regalplex for the victory.

This was a formulaic tag team match but continued to highlight the impressive rising athletes in NXT's undercard.

In particular, DVD and Romeo were flying with fire throughout, creating a whole new highlight reel of moves just from this contest.

It would have been nice to see BirthRight do more than just survive though given their significant experience advantage as a unit.

Instead, it just felt like Dempsey survived by out-wrestling Dar one-on-one in the last minute, which does not do much for BirthRight as a team.

Still, at least the right group won for the moment, hopefully setting up more focused matches for the future between these groups.

One of the babyfaces in this match should be the one to finally dethrone Lexis King as Men's Speed champion.

Dempsey, King, Stacks and Connors def. Dar, Romeo, Legacy and DVD by pinfall.

Booker T questioned who the leader of BirthRight is. Vic Joseph assumed it was Lexis King, but it is odd that has not been established five months in.

DVD was the biggest crowd favorite in this match, and his explosive offense paid off that support.

Backstage, Keanu Carver reminded an annoyed Robert Stone that the referee's decision is final while Shiloh Hill asked for a match with Naraku next week.

AAA World Cruiserweight Championship: Rey Fénix (c) vs. EK Prosper

Last Time in Action: Rey Fénix defeated Dragon Lee to advance to the finals of the World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contender Tournament (Raw, August 24); EK Prosper defeated La Parka, Romeo Moreno and Tristan Angels (NXT, August 18).

Despite a confident start from Fénix, Prosper flipped through the grip of the champion and sent him to the floor with a Dropkick.

He followed up with a Moonsault to the floor to send this match into a commercial break.

The champion fired back out of the break, only to get countered again by Prosper including a Springboard Leg Drop for a near-fall.

Fénix fired back with Adios Amigo into a Diving Crossbody and Frog Splash for his own near-fall.

Prosper countered a Rolling Cutter with a Suplex but bounced the champion into a Handspring Cutter. Prosper blocked the Mexican Muscle Buster and planted the champion with a Top-Rope Headscissors.

Fénix dodged the Moonsault followed by a Corner Enzuigiri, Superkick and Mexican Muscle Buster for the win.

Despite positioning this as the epic main event of NXT, it never truly felt like Prosper was ready for the spotlight given to him.

Fénix is one of the best luchadors going, and it felt like he was giving too much to the less experienced star to make this a genuine struggle.

There was little drama to the finish as Fénix was not going to lose less than a week away from the biggest match of his WWE career against Penta.

It might have been best to keep this shorter and tighter to sell that Prosper has more to learn before he can contest one of AAA's best.

Fénix def. Prosper by pinfall to retain the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship.

While the main roster has not always responded to Fénix, the NXT crowd was quickly chanting "Animo" for the champion.

In the men's locker room, Myles Borne and Tavion Heights talked strategy with NASCAR racer Sam Mayer joined by Hank Walker and Tank Ledger, who wanted the next tag title shot.

Kendal Grey arrived first with Wren Sinclair, promising the NXT women's champion was a fighting champion.

Kelani Jordan arrived followed by Zaria and Kali Armstrong, all promising victory at Heatwave.

Grayson Waller interrupted to talk up the talent in the arena before telling them that it was time for them to all let him talk.

Tony D'Angelo told Waller that he would fail like he always does. Cruz Montana arrived to declare himself a fighter not a talker, starting a brawl including security.

Zilla Fatu arrived late to take out his competition, raising the NXT Championship, while Grey and Wren held the NXT Women's, Women's North American and Women's Speed Championships high.

While the crowd popped big for Zilla and NXT got a nice final shot of possible winners standing tall, this was a mess that did no one any favors.

Waller has quickly lost steam due to the messy build of the NXT Championship match and looked like a chump in the chaos.

WrenQCC stood tall by the end, but most of the challengers got a forgettable 10 seconds to speak on a night that needed to solidify more stars.

Even if the goal is to sell fans on the "chaos" of NXT, this did not serve as a final exclamation mark before Heatwave. It was just the same-old NXT standard of overloading a segment without substance.

Grey threw shade at Liv Morgan, refusing to wait to defend her gold.

Waller called the women in the ring the 10%, referencing his recent line that these were the women ready for the main roster call-up.

Vic Joseph ran down the Heatwave card before the Championship Summit:

Women's North American and Speed Championship Unification: Zaria (c) vs. Wren Sinclair (c) vs. Kali Armstrong.

North American Championship: Myles Borne (c) vs. Jackson Drake.

NXT Tag Team Championships: Myles Borne and Tavion Height (c) vs. The Vanity Project's Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes.

NXT Championship: Tony D'Angelo (c) vs. Grayson Waller vs. Cruz Montana vs. Zilla Fatu.

NXT Women's Championship: Kendal Grey (c) vs. Kelani Jordan.

The go-home show to Heatwave was, in a single word, underwhelming.

Beyond Nattie and Jaida Parker maximizing their limited minutes to sell their feud ending Submission match, nothing got a boost in hype from this show.

Kali Armstrong and Zaria delivered in the ring, but she may have unnecessarily complicated a simple story between Zaria and Wren Sinclair.

Rey Fénix and EK Prosper delivered an over-the-top main event that does not connect to anything on the PLE to come. The same can be said for the opening battle of Saquon Shugars and Dion Lennox.

The main hype for the night came from the main event chaos, and that was a mess that only showed that the main angles for Heatwave have been rushed.

articles.title: SEC joins Big Ten in banning pros from returning to college, includes basketball players
articles.summary: The rule bans players who have been drafted by NFL, NBA, or WNBA teams or listed on their rosters.
articles.body: The Southeastern Conference passed a rule Tuesday banning players who have been drafted by NFL, NBA or WNBA teams or listed on rosters in those leagues, joining the Big Ten in taking a strong stand against this month’s unexpected surge of pro players trying to return to college. The SEC’s rule differs from the one adopted by the Big Ten, which only included football in its decision released earlier in the day. Combined, it leaves little doubt about where the nation’s two biggest conferences stand in the wake of court orders that were allowing players who had been on pro rosters, then released, to return back to college. It puts LSU on notice. This week, Tigers coach Lane Kiffin added Dae’Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, a pair of undrafted players out of Mississippi who had tryouts in the NFL over the summer but were released by their teams during training camp.

articles.summary: Conoce cuáles son las predicciones para este día
articles.body: Desde hace tiempo, Mhoni Vidente se ha convertido en una de las más grandes referencias en cuanto a astrología, ya que gracias a sus predicciones podemos saber más sobre cuestiones del destino y futuro en temas que son de gran importancia para nosotros como el dinero, amor, abundancia, suerte, trabajo, salud y más. Es por ello que en esta ocasión, te diremos cuáles serán las predicciones de este día, es decir hoy miércoles 26 de agosto de 2026, de acuerdo a lo que la vidente cubana nos puede decir acerca de nuestra fortuna para cada uno de los signos zodiacales. Gracias a la influencia favorable de Júpiter, hoy te espera un día marcadamente positivo, especialmente en los asuntos que se relacionen con el trabajo y las finanzas, así como las iniciativas a medio o largo plazo que pongas en marcha en cualquiera de estos ámbitos. Un momento ideal para tomar decisiones importantes. Este día va a empezar para ti lleno de ilusiones y proyectos, tanto de trabajo como en tu vida privada, sin embargo, según las horas vayan avanzando te vas a ir desfondando un poco, pero no porque algo te vaya a salir mal, sino porque lentamente vas a dejarte llevar por un mayor pesimismo, o problemas sin importancia. Como viene siendo muy frecuente durante este verano, hoy tendrás un día bien dispuesto y fructífero, en gran parte porque también tú te sentirás animado o ilusionado. La suerte, y las ocasiones favorables, van a estar contigo, tanto en los asuntos de trabajo como los de carácter personal. Afortunado para relacionarte. Afortunadamente, hoy todo va a ser muy diferente a como te lo esperas. Comenzarás el día bastante desanimado, o quizás no te encontrarás muy bien, sin embargo, va a terminar siendo un día muy afortunado, en el que el destino te tiene reservada una enorme alegría, que afectará tanto a tu trabajo como a tu vida íntima. Este va a ser para ti un día de gran actividad, grandes proyectos y grandes ilusiones; además, la suerte está contigo y muchas de las cosas por las que luchas y te mueves, tarde o temprano van a acabar viniendo a tus manos. Favorable para los asuntos financieros y mundanos, pero también para viajar o recibir visitas lejanas. Tan malo es hacer las cosas de modo temerario y alocado, como hacerlas muy bien planificadas, pero paralizarte por el miedo a que te salgan mal, y esto último es lo que te podría suceder hoy. En este momento los temores van a ser tus peores enemigos y debes luchar contra ellos, o estos te impedirán hacer realidad tus sueños. Hoy puede ser un día realmente muy bueno para ti, en el caso de que ya estés de vuelta en el trabajo, porque vas a disponer de una habilidad, mano izquierda y astucia bastante mayor de lo habitual. Eludirás el protagonismo y te mantendrás en segundo plano, sin embargo, vas a conseguir que se hagan las cosas como tú quieres. El excelente tránsito de Júpiter, del que vas a disfrutar a lo largo del próximo invierno y primavera, te va a traer mucha suerte en los asuntos relacionados con el trabajo, finanzas y vida social. Hoy mismo vas a tener una breve muestra de ello. Entras en un periodo ideal para tomar todo tipo de iniciativas, con éxitos inesperados. Según el mes de agosto se va terminando y se acerque cada vez más el comienzo del nuevo curso, te esperan acontecimientos muy afortunados que te indicarán que se abre un ciclo muy afortunado para ti, sobre todo en los asuntos de trabajo y de tipo material o social. Tendrás mucha suerte en los viajes o en países extranjeros. Sobre tus hombros van a caer grandes responsabilidades, tanto si te las imponen las circunstancias en tu trabajo, como si eres tú mismo quien te las impones. Tendrás que tomar decisiones importantes que podrían influir mucho en tu futuro. Pero no te asustes por ello, porque lo vas a hacer mejor de lo que crees y tendrás suerte. Debes perseverar hasta el final, aunque todo sea mucho más complicado de lo que te parecía en un principio. Tú no sueles interesarte por cosas fáciles, sino por objetivos difíciles e importantes, que merecen la pena y te permitirán ayudar a otras personas. La tarea de hoy es no ceder y seguir adelante, el triunfo está contigo. Tienes un gran corazón, y siempre te interesas, sinceramente, por las personas que están pasando dificultades, incluso si no están entre tus amigos o familiares. Pero también, tal como te va a suceder hoy, una actitud tan noble y desinteresada suele llevarte, a menudo, a sufrir dolorosos desengaños que el destino te compensará.
